remediationQuery.mode.autoHelp: New findings that match are added automatically, for long-running work.
remediationQuery.mode.guardNotify: You are told in-app when findings are added. You can pause it at any time.
remediationQuery.mode.guardScope: It always runs with your current access, never more.
remediationQuery.mode.guardSuspend: It stops by itself if you leave the organization or lose access to findings or remediation.
remediationQuery.mode.guardUnclaimed: Only findings that are not already in another open task are added.

remediationQuery.mode.snapshotHelp: The task keeps the findings that match now. Re-run the query later to add new matches after you confirm.

remediationQuery.preview.scopeMine: Counted over the findings in your data scope.
remediationQuery.preview.tooMany: More than {max} findings match: one task holds at most {max}. Narrow the query, or split the work into several tasks under a campaign.
remediationQuery.task.autoFailed: Auto include could not be changed.

remediationQuery.task.reason.query_inval: Suspended: the query no longer works for the person it runs as. Create a new task with a corrected query.
